protocols.title: N-Acetyl Selank Amidate intranasal schedule — source reference
protocols.purpose: Source-reported intranasal research schedule; amidate-specific clinical dosing is not established
protocols.population: Research reference; dosing is extrapolated from Selank because amidate-specific data are limited
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org states that official N-Acetyl Selank Amidate dosing guidelines are lacking and extrapolates from Selank. Its reference schedule is 600–900 mcg/day intranasally, using 300 mcg per pump 2–3 times daily, for up to 14 days; its chart shows a one-week washout followed by a repeat two-week course. It says not to exceed 9 pumps/day and recommends monitoring EEG and clinical status. This is not a validated clinical regimen.

schedule.description: One 300 mcg pump per administration, 2–3 times daily (600–900 mcg total/day), as reported by the source. The page also states a ceiling of 9 pumps/day; its reference course advises not exceeding 14 consecutive days.
One-week washout between courses, as shown in the source's chart.
The chart repeats 1 pump (300 mcg) 2–3 times daily, for 600–900 mcg total/day.

regimen.notes: Peptides.org says amidate-specific dosing guidelines and cycle-length data are lacking; recommendations are extrapolated from Selank. Its reference schedule is 2 weeks on, 1 week washout, then an optional/repeated 2-week course. It advises monitoring EEG and clinical status. Source-reported research reference only.

protocols.title: N-Acetyl Selank Amidate subcutaneous schedule — source reference
protocols.purpose: Separate source-reported subcutaneous research schedule; amidate-specific clinical dosing is not established
protocols.population: Research reference; dosing is extrapolated from Selank because amidate-specific data are limited
protocols.evidenceNotes: Peptides.org describes a conservative subcutaneous reference of 150–300 mcg daily for up to two weeks, followed by a washout week and a possible repeat two-week course. The page states that amidate-specific dosing and safety data are lacking; this is not a validated clinical regimen.

schedule.description: 150–300 mcg total per day for up to two weeks, as the page's conservative subcutaneous reference.
One-week washout between courses, as shown in the source chart.
The chart repeats the 150–300 mcg daily reference for weeks 4–5.

regimen.notes: Source describes 150–300 mcg/day conservatively for up to two weeks, with a one-week washout and possible repeat two-week course. It notes subcutaneous injection and limited amidate-specific data. Research reference only.
